title: PSYCHO-PASS : Inspector Akane Tsunemori
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a future Japan, the Sibyl System measures each citizen's mind and crime potential, called the Psycho-Pass, and plans their lives (MAL; MANGA MILLION blurb). Rookie Inspector Akane Tsunemori works with Enforcers, latent criminals armed with Dominator guns, and encounters a criminal whose Psycho-Pass reads as righteous. The manga retells the first anime season from Akane's point of view (MAL).
life_message: Conscience and personal judgment must hold even when a powerful system claims to measure right and wrong for everyone.

delivery.note: The system's case is set against Akane's conscience; how fairly each side is given is not settled by the sources.
